Why should I use MacReviver?
MacReviver offers numerous space saving, organizing and security features that are indispensable for the modern Mac user.
If you are looking to track down duplicate files, get more life out of your battery, remove junk files, protect your Mac in case of theft, and do more to keep your Mac running smoothly and reliably, you need MacReviver for your Mac.
Think of it as an easy to use, collection of tools designed to optimize and maintain your Mac in a few easy clicks.
